jobs.title: VP, Consulting & Transformation
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a VP, Consulting & Transformation based in the Canada .

We are seeking an accomplished consulting leader to build and scale a multidisciplinary practice at the intersection of digital commerce, business strategy, and transformation. In this senior leadership role, you will guide clients from complex business challenges and early-stage discovery to actionable, funded transformation roadmaps. You will oversee expertise spanning strategy, AI advisory, CRM and lifecycle, conversion optimization, and search, while connecting recommendations to measurable business outcomes. Beyond leading client engagements, you will drive commercial growth, strengthen strategic partnerships, and expand long-term client relationships. You will also shape the practice’s offerings, operating model, and talent, helping organizations navigate an evolving commerce ecosystem and make the most of emerging AI capabilities.

Accountabilities

Consulting and Transformation Leadership
Lead senior client engagements across digital and AI transformation, platform selection and replatforming, international expansion, B2B commerce, retail and point of sale (POS), loyalty, marketplaces, data, and operating models.
Facilitate structured discovery across business objectives, customer insights, data, technology, organizational capabilities, and operating models.
Translate complex or ambiguous client needs into clear goals, identified gaps, prioritized initiatives, and practical transformation plans.
Develop compelling business cases that connect strategic roadmaps to funded initiatives, prioritizing opportunities based on business impact, customer value, effort, and dependencies.
Create multi-year transformation roadmaps that define the desired future state and the steps required to achieve it.
Provide independent recommendations on the best path forward for clients, including partner or co-delivery models when their needs extend beyond internal delivery capabilities.

Client Retention, Account Expansion, and Commercial Growth
Own long-term strategic plans for top-tier retained clients, aligned with their one-, three-, and five-year business objectives.
Lead or co-lead Growth Councils and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) alongside Client Partners, focusing on future opportunities, measurable return on investment, and business outcomes.
Bring together strategy, AI and transformation, CRM and lifecycle, conversion optimization, SEO/GEO/AEO, design, and technology perspectives into a unified client growth strategy.
Help evolve client relationships from individual project delivery into broader, multi-service partnerships.
Contribute strategic judgment to client health assessments and monthly intelligence reporting, complementing AI-generated analysis.
Ensure consulting services are clearly scoped, priced, and incorporated into retainers and new engagements.
Support strategic sales opportunities by bringing senior-level transformation expertise into client conversations and pitches.
Shape the scope and strategic approach of complex, multidisciplinary proposals before pricing, ensuring recommendations are differentiated and outcome-oriented.
Own and continuously refine the strategic positioning and pitch narrative, presenting the business as a comprehensive digital services and transformation partner rather than solely a platform implementation provider.

Practice Leadership and Commercial Performance
Lead and develop a multidisciplinary consulting practice covering strategy, conversion rate optimization, CRM and lifecycle, SEO/GEO/AEO, and emerging AI services.
Maintain a strong understanding of each discipline, including its core performance indicators, methodologies, and applications across project-based and retained engagements.
Own practice quality, methodologies, playbooks, team structure, performance management, and day-to-day operations.
Carry responsibility for practice margin and utilization targets.
Build scalable documentation, frameworks, and evaluation criteria that enable each discipline to grow beyond the capabilities of individual contributors.
Turn successful pilots, managed services, and AI commerce capabilities into repeatable offerings with clearly defined scope and pricing.
Shape the practice's perspective on the broader digital commerce ecosystem, including search and discovery, personalization, lifecycle messaging, loyalty, subscriptions, PIM, ERP, OMS, DAM, data, and AI tools.
Advise clients on whether their existing technology stack supports their growth ambitions and competitive requirements, and identify where investment or reinvention is needed.

AI Transformation and People Leadership
Champion the practical application of AI in client transformation roadmaps, connecting emerging capabilities to measurable business value.
Bring AI-enabled capabilities into sales and advisory conversations, including AI discoverability, agentic commerce operations, and technology partner stack advisory.
Redesign consulting methodologies and discipline deliverables for AI-native workflows, with a focus on measurable improvements.
Mentor and develop discipline leaders, building trust while encouraging continuous improvement, stronger performance, and revenue growth.
Establish clear performance standards and develop a leadership bench capable of operating independently and delivering results.
Hold direct reports and practice leaders accountable for outcomes, ownership, and execution.

Requirements

At least 10 years of experience in consulting, strategy, or senior client leadership, including substantial experience in a senior client-facing role at an agency, digital consultancy, or consulting firm.
Proven track record leading digital transformation engagements from ambiguous business challenges through funded roadmaps and successful delivery.
Experience leading a consulting or strategy function and managing a multidisciplinary team or practice.
Demonstrated ability to define consulting offerings, establish methodologies, manage commercial performance, and build and develop leadership teams.
Strong experience developing and defending business cases for digital transformation initiatives, including ROI modeling and prioritization frameworks.
Proven success growing retained or recurring revenue relationships, beyond acquiring new business.
Strong understanding of digital commerce growth drivers, including demand generation, conversion, customer lifecycle and retention, merchandising, average order value (AOV), and the data connecting these areas.
Ability to provide credible strategic recommendations across multiple disciplines while effectively guiding specialist leaders.
Deep familiarity with the digital commerce ecosystem, including platforms, partner networks, applications, and enterprise systems.
Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect strategic recommendations to client value, investment requirements, and expected returns.
Excellent executive communication, relationship management, leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills.
Ability to balance strategic vision with hands-on execution, team development, and accountability for business outcomes.

Benefits

Competitive healthcare coverage, including dental and vision insurance.
Retirement savings plan with employer matching.
Competitive paid time off (PTO) policy, including paid time off at the end of the year.
Flexible working schedule.
Remote-first work culture.
Home office stipend.
Apple equipment.
Continued education and professional development opportunities.

to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

jobs.title: Project Controls Director
jobs.description:
Overview

AtkinsRéalis is seeking a highly experienced Project Controls Director to lead integrated project controls on a major capital infrastructure project delivered through a collaborative delivery model. As a key member of the integrated project leadership team, you will work alongside clients, delivery partners, designers, contractors, and stakeholders to align scope, schedule, cost, risk, change, commercial performance, and reporting.

This role offers the opportunity to shape project outcomes through data-driven decision-making, transparent governance, and collaborative leadership. If you are passionate about delivering complex engineering and infrastructure projects while driving innovation, accountability, and project excellence, we want to hear from you.

Your Role

Lead integrated project controls across the project leadership team, ensuring alignment between clients, delivery partners, designers, contractors, and commercial teams.
Develop and govern a single integrated project controls framework, including baselines, data standards, reporting processes, and accountability structures.
Facilitate integrated planning, schedule development, milestone alignment, and forecasting activities across multiple organizations.
Lead the management of cost, schedule, risk, opportunity, change, and performance reporting to support project objectives and key performance indicators.
Provide performance insights, scenario analysis, and option evaluations to support evidence-based decision-making and project optimization.
Develop integrated dashboards, reports, and executive presentations that provide a common source of truth for project teams and governance forums.
Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary project controls teams while driving continuous improvement, collaboration, and knowledge sharing.

About You

Ability to lead project controls functions on large, complex capital or infrastructure projects with a minimum of 15 years of relevant experience.
Proficiency in integrated planning and scheduling, cost management, risk and opportunity management, change control, forecasting, performance measurement, and executive reporting.
Ability to establish integrated project controls processes, shared data environments, common baselines, and transparent reporting frameworks across multiple organizations.
Aptitude for influencing senior stakeholders, facilitating collaborative decision-making, resolving conflicts, and building alignment within complex project environments.
Proficiency in project controls systems, PMIS platforms, common data environments, data visualization tools, and reporting software.

Rewards & Benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.

Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.

Make the most of diverse opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise.

And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

Additional Information

AtkinsRéalis cares about your privacy. AtkinsRéalis and other subsidiary or affiliated companies of AtkinsRéalis (referred to throughout as "AtkinsRéalis") are committed to protecting your privacy. Please consult our Privacy Notice on our Careers site to know more about how we collect, use, and transfer your Personal Data.

jobs.title: Director, Capital Markets
jobs.description:
Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Business - Infrastructure

Brookfield Infrastructure Group is one of Brookfield’s primary operating groups. The Infrastructure Group is one of the world’s largest infrastructure investors, owning and operating critical assets across the transport, utilities, energy, and data infrastructure sectors. The Group operates and manages approximately $262 billion of assets owned through its private funds and publicly listed entity, Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Our portfolio of assets facilitate the movement and storage of energy, water, freight, passengers and data, and are located in North and South America, Europe and the Asia Pacific regions. For more information, visit: https://www.brookfield.com/our-businesses/infrastructure

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Primary Responsibilities

Support the liquidity management process, staying abreast of investment and capital recycling activity and helping to keep senior management informed through weekly/quarterly reporting
Support the credit ratings process, including analysis of rating methodologies and preparing materials for rating agency presentations
Support financial risk management activities, including risk reporting, assisting with devising strategies to hedge foreign exchange and interest rate risk, and coordinating hedge execution
Support external financing activities for the public entity and its subsidiaries, in debt and equity capital markets transactions
Manage reporting of comprehensive treasury and risk management materials on a quarterly basis, provided to the Board and senior management across the organization
Remain well-informed of capital markets and Brookfield’s investment strategies
Prepare ad-hoc analysis and participate in ad-hoc projects as required

Qualifications & Requirements

Degree in finance, accounting, or related business discipline
Completed CPA, CFA or related designation is an asset
Minimum 5+ years of experience in Finance (including accounting treasury, corporate finance and/or capital markets)
Self-motivated and proactive, with respect to both managing workload and professional development
Team player with positive attitude and willingness to adapt to changing work priorities
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, can work effectively with all levels and departments within a complex organization
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, can simplify complex issues and provide solutions or recommendations in a clear and concise manner

Compensation Range: $165,000 - $185,000CAD

New Position

Applicant information is collected and handled in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. As part of this commitment, we provide barrier-free and accessible employment practices in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and applicable human rights legislation. jobs.title: Senior Director, Sales B2B North America (Supply)
jobs.description:
Mistplay est l'application de fidélité n°1 pour les joueurs mobiles. Notre communauté de millions de joueurs mobiles engagés utilise Mistplay pour découvrir de nouveaux jeux et gagner des récompenses. Les joueurs sont récompensés pour le temps et l'argent qu'ils consacrent aux jeux et peuvent échanger ces récompenses contre des cartes cadeaux. Mistplay a pour mission d'être le meilleur moyen de jouer à des jeux mobiles pour tous, partout dans le monde ! Téléchargez Mistplay sur le Google Play Store  ici  et suivez-nous sur  Instagram ,  Twitter  et  Facebook .

📍 Veuillez noter :
Au Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay suit un modèle hybride de 2 jours/semaine en bureau à Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montréal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

Mistplay is the #1 loyalty app for mobile gamers. Our community of millions of engaged mobile gamers come to Mistplay to discover new games to play and earn rewards. Gamers are rewarded for their time and money spent within the games and can redeem those rewards for gift cards. Mistplay is on a mission to be the best way to play mobile games for everyone everywhere! Download Mistplay on the Google Play Store  here  and follow us on  Instagram ,  Twitter  and  Facebook .

📍 Please Note:
In Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay follows a 2 days/week in-office hybrid model in Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montreal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

English Description:

Mistplay is the category creator and leader in the 'play-and-earn' mobile loyalty space, built to reward gamers for playing.

LoyaltyPlay is our B2B monetization platform, a powerful Gaming Reward Hub designed for mobile app Publishers. We partner with app owners (e.g., utility, commerce, or entertainment apps) to help them unlock a new, consistent revenue stream and boost user engagement. By integrating LoyaltyPlay, publishers can offer their users rewards (in-app currency) for installing and playing mobile games from our vast advertiser network. This creates a deep engagement loop and a powerful monetization channel for the publisher.

This is a high-impact role selling a differentiated, performance-based monetization solution to a global mobile app audience.

The Opportunity

Mistplay is looking for a seasoned North American sales leader to provide hands-on leadership for our growing, distributed team. This is a pivotal "player-coach" role designed for a leader who excels at operational excellence, performance management, and high-level deal strategy.

We aren't looking for a traditional executive to sit behind a dashboard; we need a practitioner who can credibly coach senior sellers, dive into complex enterprise negotiations, and instill a culture of accountability and consistent execution across the region.

What you’ll do at Misplay

Lead & Coach:
Manage a distributed team of experienced Account Executives, providing the prioritization and day-to-day support they need to win.

Deal Strategy:
Act as the "executive sponsor" on major enterprise deals, joining high-value meetings to provide strategic weight and help navigate complex procurement and legal cycles.

Operational Rigor:
Partner with leadership to design realistic goals and commission plans that drive the right behaviors.

Performance Management:
Maintain deep visibility into the North American pipeline, identifying bottlenecks and providing thoughtful coaching to help reps over-perform.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Serve as the bridge between Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to ensure our "win" in the market is supported by a seamless internal experience.

Process Architecture:
Create structure and consistency across the sales motion without adding "bureaucracy for bureaucracy's sake."

Who You Are

Proven Leader:
10–15 years of experience in enterprise B2B sales, with a significant portion dedicated to managing high-performing, senior-level reps.

Credible Coach:
You’ve been a top-tier individual contributor in the past and can hold your own in a 7-figure deal room. You lead through respect and expertise, not micromanagement.

Pragmatic & Low-Ego:
You are a "doer" who is comfortable in a broad, collaborative role. You care more about the team’s success than title or hierarchy.

Operational Mindset:
You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to build incentive plans and sales workflows that actually work in the field.

Remote-Fluent:
You have experience leading distributed teams across various time zones and know how to maintain team culture and performance from afar.

Ideal Experience

Background in Gaming, AdTech, or high-growth SaaS
partnerships.

Experience managing "full-cycle" motions, including both net-new acquisition and existing account expansion.

Proven ability to work effectively with C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500-level organizations.

What Success Looks Like

Immediate Impact:
The team feels more supported locally with clearer day-to-day guidance and prioritization.

Deal Velocity:
Strategic opportunities move through the funnel faster due to your direct involvement in deal architecture.

Consistency:
The North American region becomes a "predictable engine" for the company, with high visibility into pipeline and consistent quota attainment.

Description en Français: 

Mistplay est le créateur de la catégorie et le leader dans l'espace de fidélisation mobile « jouer-pour-gagner » ( play-and-earn ), conçu pour récompenser les joueurs.

LoyaltyPlay est notre plateforme de monétisation B2B, un puissant Centre de Récompenses de Jeu ( Gaming Reward Hub ) conçu pour les éditeurs d'applications mobiles. Nous travaillons en partenariat avec les propriétaires d'applications (par exemple, des applications utilitaires, commerciales ou de divertissement) pour les aider à débloquer un nouveau flux de revenus constant et à stimuler l'engagement des utilisateurs. En intégrant LoyaltyPlay, les éditeurs peuvent offrir à leurs utilisateurs des récompenses (devise intégrée à l'application) pour l'installation et le jeu d'applications mobiles provenant de notre vaste réseau d'annonceurs. Cela crée une boucle d'engagement profonde et un puissant canal de monétisation pour l'éditeur.

Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact qui consiste à vendre une solution de monétisation différenciée et axée sur la performance à un public mondial d'applications mobiles.

L'opportunité

Mistplay est à la recherche d'un leader des ventes nord-américain expérimenté pour assurer un leadership concret auprès de notre équipe croissante et distribuée. Il s'agit d'un rôle central de « joueur-entraîneur » ( player-coach ), conçu pour un leader qui excelle en matière d'excellence opérationnelle, de gestion de la performance et de stratégie de transactions de haut niveau.

Nous ne cherchons pas un dirigeant traditionnel pour siéger derrière un tableau de bord; nous avons besoin d'un praticien qui peut entraîner de manière crédible des vendeurs chevronnés, plonger dans des négociations d'entreprise complexes et insuffler une culture de responsabilisation et d'exécution constante dans toute la région.

Ce que vous ferez chez Misplay

Diriger et encadrer:
Gérer une équipe distribuée de Directeurs de comptes expérimentés, en leur offrant la priorisation et le soutien quotidiens dont ils ont besoin pour réussir.

Stratégie de transactions:
Agir en tant que « parrain exécutif » sur les transactions majeures avec les entreprises, en participant à des réunions de grande valeur pour apporter un poids stratégique et aider à naviguer dans les cycles complexes d'approvisionnement et juridiques.

Rigueur opérationnelle:
Travailler en partenariat avec la direction pour concevoir des objectifs réalistes et des plans de commissionnement qui incitent aux bons comportements.

Gestion de la performance:
Maintenir une visibilité approfondie sur le pipeline nord-américain, identifier les goulots d'étranglement et fournir un encadrement réfléchi pour aider les représentants à se surpasser.

Collaboration interfonctionnelle:
Servir de pont entre les ventes, la réussite client ( Customer Success ) et les opérations pour garantir que notre « victoire » sur le marché est soutenue par une expérience interne fluide.

Architecture de processus:
Créer une structure et une cohérence pour l'ensemble du processus de vente sans ajouter de « bureaucratie pour le plaisir de la bureaucratie ».

Who you are

Leader éprouvé:
10 à 15 ans d'expérience dans la vente interentreprises (B2B), dont une partie importante dédiée à la gestion de représentants de haut niveau et très performants.

Entraîneur crédible:
Vous avez été un contributeur individuel de premier plan par le passé et vous pouvez vous affirmer lors d'une transaction de 7 chiffres. Vous dirigez par le respect et l'expertise, et non par la microgestion.

Pragmatique et sans égo:
Vous êtes une personne d'action (« doer ») à l'aise dans un rôle vaste et collaboratif. Vous vous souciez plus du succès de l'équipe que du titre ou de la hiérarchie.

Mentalité opérationnelle:
Vous possédez un excellent jugement commercial et savez comment élaborer des plans d'incitation et des flux de travail de vente qui fonctionnent réellement sur le terrain.

Habitué au travail à distance (
Remote-Fluent ): Vous avez de l'expérience dans la direction d'équipes distribuées à travers différents fuseaux horaires et savez comment maintenir la culture et la performance de l'équipe à distance.

Expérience idéale

Expérience dans les partenariats de jeu (
Gaming
), AdTech, ou SaaS à forte croissance
.

Expérience de la gestion des cycles de vente complets (« full-cycle »), y compris l'acquisition de nouveaux comptes et l'expansion des comptes existants.

Capacité éprouvée à travailler efficacement avec des parties prenantes de niveau C dans des organisations de type Fortune 500.

À quoi ressemble le succès

Impact immédiat:
L'équipe se sent plus soutenue localement grâce à une orientation quotidienne et une priorisation plus claires.

Vitesse des transactions (
Deal Velocity
):
Les opportunités stratégiques progressent plus rapidement dans l'entonnoir grâce à votre implication directe dans l'architecture des transactions.

Cohérence:
La région nord-américaine devient un « moteur prévisible » pour l'entreprise, avec une grande visibilité sur le pipeline et une atteinte des quotas cohérente.

*Nous remercions tous(tes) les candidat(e)s. Le genre masculin a été utilisé dans le but d'alléger le texte. Nous souscrivons au principe de l’équité en matière d’emploi.

Pourquoi choisir Mistplay ?

Nous faisons tout pour rendre notre environnement de travail aussi accueillant et plaisant que possible ! Un poste chez Mistplay s’accompagne de toute une série d'avantages que nous proposons en mode virtuel ou présentiel : déjeuners d'équipe, soirées jeux, événements à l'échelle de l'entreprise, et bien plus encore.
Notre culture est profondément ancrée dans la croissance et soutenue par une équipe de personnes intelligentes, dynamiques et enthousiastes. Nous utilisons les données pour apprendre, améliorer et adapter en permanence. Nous favorisons un environnement dans lequel chacun est encouragé à partager ses idées, à repousser les limites, à prendre des risques calculés et à voir ses visions se concrétiser.

Why Mistplay?

We strive to make our work environment as inviting and fun as possible! Working at Mistplay is coupled with a whole array of perks that we've adopted virtually and in-person: Team Lunches, game nights, company-wide events, and so much more.   Our culture is deeply rooted in growth and upheld by a team of smart, dynamic, and enthusiastic people. We utilize data to constantly learn, improve, and adapt. We foster an environment where everyone is encouraged to share their ideas, push boundaries, take calculated risks, and witness their visions come to life.

jobs.title: Director Lead Solution Architecture
jobs.description:
Job Description

RBC Wealth Management technology group is looking for an experienced Lead Solution Architect. RBCWM technology team is undertaking multiple complex organization-wide initiatives as part our transformational agenda to deliver on our functions strategic goals and to align with RBC’s technology strategy. You will partner with IT and business stakeholders to develop the end-to-end technical solution architectures for high-complexity and high-risk IT initiatives to meet sponsor needs. You will work primarily on initiatives that may span multiple projects, many applications, and third parties with complex integration requirements. Your efforts will achieve a rationalized portfolio of effective business and technology solutions cost-effective to the business. Success in this role will be measured by your ability to leverage shared services and reduce redundancy, technical debt and complexity.

What will you do?

Designing (SA) in large or complex programs, including system and application designs, software and technical architecture, in accordance with strategies and objectives.
Providing expertise for the (SA) team and other IT staff on a variety of issues in software designs, system architecture and solution-oriented technologies.
Influence in decision making and facilitate teams with multiple stakeholders at all levels in the organization.
Overseeing (SA) project outcomes, software design; ensuring that each project phase meets overall requirements.
Translate business requirements into solutions to support the overall program, RBC security policy, WM technology strategy, focusing on architecture blueprints, capabilities models, and proven enterprise patterns.
Help drive the organization towards targeted architecture states and improve the maturity of the architecture practice.
Develop ongoing knowledge of current and emerging technologies.
Participate in day-to-day execution of the architecture strategy.
Develop blueprints and conduct design reviews to ensure architectural compliance of solutions.
Maintain a plan to address gaps between current and target state architectures.
Facilitate collaboration within the organization and support the architecture lead and senior architects.
Work across multiple projects and systems to develop, communicate, and mentor others on solution design, implementation and operation patterns and best practices.

What do you need to succeed?

Must have:

Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or an equivalent analytic-intensive field.
Strong experience in information technology development, design and architecture roles.
Strong experience developing architectures on large data projects and proven results with an extensive program from initiation to implementation.
Advanced knowledge on client facing Web / Mobile application architecture patterns, security patterns including OAuth, SSO, SAML, etc., service integrations and service development architectures.
Advanced knowledge on different architecture/design techniques (e.g. SOA/Microservices, REST/SOAP, Cloud Native applications, Event-Driven Architecture, Orchestration / Choreography, Data Pipelines), modern and legacy technology platforms (e.g. Kafka, MQ, Openshift, RBDMS, GraphQL, NoSQL, Snowflake, etc.).
Solid experience in designing resilient enterprise applications using On Premises and Cloud computing platforms.
Demonstrated ability in written and oral communication skills along with strong presentation skills. Ability to communicate and discuss complex topics with technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to have
:

Strong knowledge of financial applications as well as host-based systems
Experience in modernization of client facing applications.
Familiarity with the Machine Learning life cycle
Experience building and deploying solutions to public cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, etc.)
Good awareness and experience in public and private cloud platforms would be an added value.
Advanced digital platform skills, modernizing the legacy platforms with all options on architectures would be an asset.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable.

Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact.
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team.
A world-class training program.
Flexible work/life balance options
Opportunities to do challenging work.

Applications Architecture, Architectural Modeling, Creativity, Critical Thinking, Enterprise IT Architecture, Information Technology Consulting, Multi-Level Communication, Software Product Design, System Applications, Transitional Architecture

new_jobs.description:
Mistplay est l'application de fidélité n°1 pour les joueurs mobiles. Notre communauté de millions de joueurs mobiles engagés utilise Mistplay pour découvrir de nouveaux jeux et gagner des récompenses. Les joueurs sont récompensés pour le temps et l'argent qu'ils consacrent aux jeux et peuvent échanger ces récompenses contre des cartes cadeaux. Mistplay a pour mission d'être le meilleur moyen de jouer à des jeux mobiles pour tous, partout dans le monde ! Téléchargez Mistplay sur le Google Play Store  ici  et suivez-nous sur  Instagram ,  Twitter  et  Facebook .

📍 Veuillez noter :
Au Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay suit un modèle hybride de 2 jours/semaine en bureau à Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montréal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

Mistplay is the #1 loyalty app for mobile gamers. Our community of millions of engaged mobile gamers come to Mistplay to discover new games to play and earn rewards. Gamers are rewarded for their time and money spent within the games and can redeem those rewards for gift cards. Mistplay is on a mission to be the best way to play mobile games for everyone everywhere! Download Mistplay on the Google Play Store  here  and follow us on  Instagram ,  Twitter  and  Facebook .

📍 Please Note:
In Canada 🇨🇦, Mistplay follows a 2 days/week in-office hybrid model in Toronto (400 University Ave) & Montreal (1001 Blvd. Robert-Bourassa)

English Description:

Mistplay is the category creator and leader in the 'play-and-earn' mobile loyalty space, built to reward gamers for playing.

LoyaltyPlay is our B2B monetization platform, a powerful Gaming Reward Hub designed for mobile app Publishers. We partner with app owners (e.g., utility, commerce, or entertainment apps) to help them unlock a new, consistent revenue stream and boost user engagement. By integrating LoyaltyPlay, publishers can offer their users rewards (in-app currency) for installing and playing mobile games from our vast advertiser network. This creates a deep engagement loop and a powerful monetization channel for the publisher.

This is a high-impact role selling a differentiated, performance-based monetization solution to a global mobile app audience.

The Opportunity

Mistplay is looking for a seasoned North American sales leader to provide hands-on leadership for our growing, distributed team. This is a pivotal "player-coach" role designed for a leader who excels at operational excellence, performance management, and high-level deal strategy.

We aren't looking for a traditional executive to sit behind a dashboard; we need a practitioner who can credibly coach senior sellers, dive into complex enterprise negotiations, and instill a culture of accountability and consistent execution across the region.

What you’ll do at Misplay

Lead & Coach:
Manage a distributed team of experienced Account Executives, providing the prioritization and day-to-day support they need to win.

Deal Strategy:
Act as the "executive sponsor" on major enterprise deals, joining high-value meetings to provide strategic weight and help navigate complex procurement and legal cycles.

Operational Rigor:
Partner with leadership to design realistic goals and commission plans that drive the right behaviors.

Performance Management:
Maintain deep visibility into the North American pipeline, identifying bottlenecks and providing thoughtful coaching to help reps over-perform.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Serve as the bridge between Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to ensure our "win" in the market is supported by a seamless internal experience.

Process Architecture:
Create structure and consistency across the sales motion without adding "bureaucracy for bureaucracy's sake."

Who You Are

Proven Leader:
10–15 years of experience in enterprise B2B sales, with a significant portion dedicated to managing high-performing, senior-level reps.

Credible Coach:
You’ve been a top-tier individual contributor in the past and can hold your own in a 7-figure deal room. You lead through respect and expertise, not micromanagement.

Pragmatic & Low-Ego:
You are a "doer" who is comfortable in a broad, collaborative role. You care more about the team’s success than title or hierarchy.

Operational Mindset:
You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to build incentive plans and sales workflows that actually work in the field.

Remote-Fluent:
You have experience leading distributed teams across various time zones and know how to maintain team culture and performance from afar.

Ideal Experience

Background in Gaming, AdTech, or high-growth SaaS
partnerships.

Experience managing "full-cycle" motions, including both net-new acquisition and existing account expansion.

Proven ability to work effectively with C-suite stakeholders at Fortune 500-level organizations.

What Success Looks Like

Immediate Impact:
The team feels more supported locally with clearer day-to-day guidance and prioritization.

Deal Velocity:
Strategic opportunities move through the funnel faster due to your direct involvement in deal architecture.

Consistency:
The North American region becomes a "predictable engine" for the company, with high visibility into pipeline and consistent quota attainment.

Description en Français: 

Mistplay est le créateur de la catégorie et le leader dans l'espace de fidélisation mobile « jouer-pour-gagner » ( play-and-earn ), conçu pour récompenser les joueurs.

LoyaltyPlay est notre plateforme de monétisation B2B, un puissant Centre de Récompenses de Jeu ( Gaming Reward Hub ) conçu pour les éditeurs d'applications mobiles. Nous travaillons en partenariat avec les propriétaires d'applications (par exemple, des applications utilitaires, commerciales ou de divertissement) pour les aider à débloquer un nouveau flux de revenus constant et à stimuler l'engagement des utilisateurs. En intégrant LoyaltyPlay, les éditeurs peuvent offrir à leurs utilisateurs des récompenses (devise intégrée à l'application) pour l'installation et le jeu d'applications mobiles provenant de notre vaste réseau d'annonceurs. Cela crée une boucle d'engagement profonde et un puissant canal de monétisation pour l'éditeur.

Il s'agit d'un rôle à fort impact qui consiste à vendre une solution de monétisation différenciée et axée sur la performance à un public mondial d'applications mobiles.

L'opportunité

Mistplay est à la recherche d'un leader des ventes nord-américain expérimenté pour assurer un leadership concret auprès de notre équipe croissante et distribuée. Il s'agit d'un rôle central de « joueur-entraîneur » ( player-coach ), conçu pour un leader qui excelle en matière d'excellence opérationnelle, de gestion de la performance et de stratégie de transactions de haut niveau.

Nous ne cherchons pas un dirigeant traditionnel pour siéger derrière un tableau de bord; nous avons besoin d'un praticien qui peut entraîner de manière crédible des vendeurs chevronnés, plonger dans des négociations d'entreprise complexes et insuffler une culture de responsabilisation et d'exécution constante dans toute la région.

Ce que vous ferez chez Misplay

Diriger et encadrer:
Gérer une équipe distribuée de Directeurs de comptes expérimentés, en leur offrant la priorisation et le soutien quotidiens dont ils ont besoin pour réussir.

Stratégie de transactions:
Agir en tant que « parrain exécutif » sur les transactions majeures avec les entreprises, en participant à des réunions de grande valeur pour apporter un poids stratégique et aider à naviguer dans les cycles complexes d'approvisionnement et juridiques.

Rigueur opérationnelle:
Travailler en partenariat avec la direction pour concevoir des objectifs réalistes et des plans de commissionnement qui incitent aux bons comportements.

Gestion de la performance:
Maintenir une visibilité approfondie sur le pipeline nord-américain, identifier les goulots d'étranglement et fournir un encadrement réfléchi pour aider les représentants à se surpasser.

Collaboration interfonctionnelle:
Servir de pont entre les ventes, la réussite client ( Customer Success ) et les opérations pour garantir que notre « victoire » sur le marché est soutenue par une expérience interne fluide.

Architecture de processus:
Créer une structure et une cohérence pour l'ensemble du processus de vente sans ajouter de « bureaucratie pour le plaisir de la bureaucratie ».

Who you are

Leader éprouvé:
10 à 15 ans d'expérience dans la vente interentreprises (B2B), dont une partie importante dédiée à la gestion de représentants de haut niveau et très performants.

Entraîneur crédible:
Vous avez été un contributeur individuel de premier plan par le passé et vous pouvez vous affirmer lors d'une transaction de 7 chiffres. Vous dirigez par le respect et l'expertise, et non par la microgestion.

Pragmatique et sans égo:
Vous êtes une personne d'action (« doer ») à l'aise dans un rôle vaste et collaboratif. Vous vous souciez plus du succès de l'équipe que du titre ou de la hiérarchie.

Mentalité opérationnelle:
Vous possédez un excellent jugement commercial et savez comment élaborer des plans d'incitation et des flux de travail de vente qui fonctionnent réellement sur le terrain.

Habitué au travail à distance (
Remote-Fluent ): Vous avez de l'expérience dans la direction d'équipes distribuées à travers différents fuseaux horaires et savez comment maintenir la culture et la performance de l'équipe à distance.

Expérience idéale

Expérience dans les partenariats de jeu (
Gaming
), AdTech, ou SaaS à forte croissance
.

Expérience de la gestion des cycles de vente complets (« full-cycle »), y compris l'acquisition de nouveaux comptes et l'expansion des comptes existants.

Capacité éprouvée à travailler efficacement avec des parties prenantes de niveau C dans des organisations de type Fortune 500.

À quoi ressemble le succès

Impact immédiat:
L'équipe se sent plus soutenue localement grâce à une orientation quotidienne et une priorisation plus claires.

Vitesse des transactions (
Deal Velocity
):
Les opportunités stratégiques progressent plus rapidement dans l'entonnoir grâce à votre implication directe dans l'architecture des transactions.

Cohérence:
La région nord-américaine devient un « moteur prévisible » pour l'entreprise, avec une grande visibilité sur le pipeline et une atteinte des quotas cohérente.
